professional_summary:
Azure Data Engineer with 4 years 10 months of overall IT experience, including 3 years 4 months of Azure Data Engineering
experience. Develops and supports Azure Data Factory pipelines integrating enterprise data across 50+ source tables with Azure
Synapse Analytics, ADLS Gen2 and Azure SQL Database. Experienced in metadata-driven and parameterized pipeline design, ADF
Linked Services, Datasets, Pipelines and Triggers, SQL timestamp-based incremental loading, data transformation, source-to-target

environments. Experienced in production monitoring, logging, error handling, retry mechanisms and root-cause analysis. Python
practice in automation and data processing outside Wipro.
